name: PostSyncer
tagline: Schedule and analyze social media posts across 11 platforms
description: Official PostSyncer MCP server. Create, schedule, draft, and repeat posts across X, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon, Pinterest, and Telegram; manage the media library, campaigns, labels, and comment moderation; and pull performance analytics. Authenticates with OAuth or a PostSyncer API token.
